page.title: CFF inbox
page.subtitle: Custom Formulation Request submissions from your Wix form
page.no_access: You do not have permission to view CFF submissions.

list.empty: No submissions yet. Once a customer fills out the Wix form, their request will appear here.

assign.open_disabled: You don't have permission to assign CFFs
assign.title: Attach CFF to project
assign.body: Pick the project this submission belongs to. The customer details are kept on the CFF so the team can refer back to the original request.
assign.select_placeholder: Search projects by code or name…
assign.no_projects: No matching projects. Create one first, then come back here.
assign.unassign_confirm_body: The CFF stays in your inbox; the project keeps its data but loses the back-link to this request.
assign.error_generic: Couldn't update the assignment. Please try again.

create_project.title: Create project from CFF
create_project.body: We'll create a new project, attach this CFF to it, and (when we can) auto-assign the sales person matched against the customer's Vita Manufacture account-manager email.
create_project.code_help: Unique per organisation. The picker uses this everywhere.
create_project.name_help: Usually the customer's brand or product name.
create_project.dosage_form_help: Pre-selected from the customer's product-format answer; change if needed.
create_project.serving_size_help: Units per dose (e.g. 2 capsules, 1 scoop). Defaults to 1.
create_project.servings_per_pack_help: Pack count divided by serving size. Defaults to 60.
create_project.description_help: Short context for the project list. Pre-filled from the CFF's market segment.
create_project.sales_preview_body: We'll try to match {email} against an org member. If they're not a member, the project is created without a sales person and you can assign one manually.
create_project.mrpeasy_required: Pick a product from MRPEasy above to continue — code and name come from the ERP on this workspace.
create_project.toast_success_no_match: Project {project} created. No team member matches {email} — assign a sales person manually from the project page.
create_project.toast_success_no_email: Project {project} created. The CFF didn't include an account-manager email, so no sales person was assigned.
create_project.toast_success_no_cap: Project {project} created. Sales-person auto-assignment was skipped — ask an admin to assign {email}.
create_project.error_generic: Couldn't create the project. Please try again.

settings.title: Wix CFF intake
settings.description: Connect the public Custom Formulation Request form hosted on your Wix site. New submissions are pulled into the CFF inbox every five minutes and your team triages them into projects from there.
settings.site_id_help: UUID of the Wix site that hosts the form (Settings → Roles & permissions → Show technical info in the Wix dashboard).
settings.form_id_help: UUID of the CFF form (visible in the form's URL in the Wix editor).
settings.namespace_help: Almost always wix.form_app.form — change only if Wix support told you to.
settings.api_key_help: Generated in your Wix account: Settings → API Keys → Generate API Key. Needs the Wix Forms scope.
settings.api_key_placeholder: Paste a fresh key — or leave blank to keep the stored one
settings.api_key_stored: Stored key — leave blank to keep it
settings.enabled_help: When off, the poller skips this org and the CFF inbox stays empty for new submissions. Previously imported rows remain browseable.
settings.confirm_clear_body: Imported submissions stay in your inbox; only future syncing stops.
settings.status_untested: Saved — click Test connection to verify

project_button.label: CFF
project_button.tooltip: View the customer's Custom Formulation Request answers
project_button.chooser_body: More than one Custom Formulation Request is attached to this project. Pick which one to read.

errors.wix_cff_not_configured: Wix CFF integration is not configured for this organisation.
errors.wix_cff_decryption_failed: Stored API key is unreadable — please re-enter it.
errors.wix_cff_auth_failed: Wix rejected the credentials. Check the API key and site ID.
errors.wix_cff_not_found: Wix could not find that form. Check the form ID.
errors.wix_cff_rate_limited: Too many requests to Wix. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.wix_cff_unreachable: Couldn't reach Wix. Try again in a moment.
errors.wix_cff_unknown_error: Something went wrong talking to Wix. Please try again.
